nodes.title: Installation and Troubleshooting
widgets_values:
KRUINS FLUX IMAGE WORKFLOW
INSTALLATION AND FIRST-TIME SETUP
========================================

DEVELOPED BY RAMPART
https://kineticruins.com

----------------------------------------
1. INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS
----------------------------------------

STEP 1:
Download the models listed in Note 1 and place them in the appropriate ComfyUI model folders.

STEP 2:
Install the custom nodes listed in Note 1 using ComfyUI Manager or their GitHub repositories.

STEP 3:
Restart ComfyUI completely and refresh your browser.

STEP 4:
Load this workflow using the JSON file or drag the workflow PNG containing embedded metadata into ComfyUI.

STEP 5:
Select your installed checkpoint, CLIP models, VAE, and upscale model in their respective dropdowns.

STEP 6:
Download the KRuins Family-Friendly Wildcard Pack from our GitHub repository.

Extract the wildcard TXT files into a folder of your choice.

STEP 7:
In the KRuins Wildcard Batch node, set wildcard_folder to the full path of your wildcard folder.

STEP 8:
Make sure KRuins Wildcard Batch batch_size matches Empty Latent Image batch_size.

A green MATCHED indicator confirms the batch sizes agree.

STEP 9:
Select your image save destination in KRuins Save Image.

STEP 10:
Click Queue Prompt to begin rendering.

----------------------------------------
2. TROUBLESHOOTING
----------------------------------------

RED BATCH SIZE WARNING:
Make sure Wildcard Batch and Empty Latent Image batch sizes match.

FILE NOT FOUND:
Check the wildcard folder path and make sure the referenced TXT file exists.

MISSING CUSTOM NODES:
Install the required nodes through ComfyUI Manager, then restart ComfyUI.

MISSING MODELS:
Verify the model files are in the correct folders, then refresh ComfyUI and select the models again.

RENDERING ERRORS:
Check GPU memory, model compatibility, and the ComfyUI console for errors.

----------------------------------------

KRuins - RENDER BEYOND IMAGINATION

Website: https://kineticruins.com
GitHub:
https://github.com/Rampart187/KRuins-ComfyUI-Node-Suite
